disorder-name.detail: Schizophrenia clinical cohort across discovery and replication samples.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "For replication sample 1, we included 94 patients with a schizophrenia diagnosis, 116 patients with a bipolar disorder diagnosis and 400 healthy individuals. As the replication sample 2, we included 312 healthy individuals, 105 with schizophrenia diagnosis and 61 with bipolar diagnosis. As the discovery sample, we selected 256 healthy individuals, 163 patients with schizophrenia and 190 with bipolar disorder."

dataset-of-origin.detail: Participants recruited from the Thematically Organized Psychosis study.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "All participants were recruited as part of the Thematically Organized Psychosis (TOP) study, approved by the Regional Committee for Medical Research Ethics and the Norwegian Data Inspectorate (Doan et al., 2017)."

answer.note: weighted mean; pooled SD across discovery and replication samples

age.detail: Weighted mean and pooled SD computed from Table 1 schizophrenia groups (N=105, 94, 163).

sex.detail: Counts and percentages computed by summing male % across schizophrenia groups in Table 1 (rounded to nearest whole) and deriving female counts from total N.
